metadata.time_note: Storm Data entry times should be reviewed in local Standard Time (ST), not daylight time. Candidate reports include standard_time_display.
metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

Two story home took a lightning strike resulting in a small fire. Minimal damage observed.

4 trees down on Carlton Drive just south of Arkabutla Lake. Time is radar estimated.

A few tree limbs and a smaller tree downed. Time is radar estimated.
Roadway flooded.
Water over roadways along East Wood Street.
Water over roadways at Franklin Drive and Valleywood Drive.
water covering roads in the Davies Plantation area_ specifically St Phillip Drive and Anderson Springs Drive. Photo from social media.
Flooding reported on Kirby Whitten Rd north of I-40.
Report of limbs down on CR 97 in Ingomar before storms arrived.
NWS employee reported road closures due to significant flooding at Poplar and Union/Walnut Grove in Midtown.
Small limb knocked over due to outflow boundary and broke windshield in Saltillo at 1 along Euclatubba Rd.
Trees down along road 811 near the Natchez Trace associated with winds from the outflow boundary.
Trees across powerlines on Bramblewood Circle in Belden. Due to outflow boundary winds.
Wind gust associated with the outflow boundary blew trees and powerlines down.
Tree down on Central street near Plant street due to winds from the outflow boundary.
Stateline Rd between Whitworth and Millbranch is closed due to flooding. There are also reports of flooding on Stateline Rd near Horn Lake Rd.
Hwy 51 south of Stateline Rd to Veterans Dr. is closed due to flooding.
Water over roadways.
Street flooding along HWY 49.
Report of water over HW 49 and Old Little Rock Road. Time is radar estimated.
East Mitchell Street in Trimble is closed due to a downed tree and electrical lines blocking the roadway. Time is radar estimated.
Downed electric lines has been reported in the Nora Drive / Edward Street area of Newbern. Time is radar estimated.
Heavy rain has led to a flooded parking lot.
Tree and minor building damage reported in downtown Sharon.
Tree down blocking north bound lane of Munford Giltedge Rd and Sturdivant Rd.
Tree down on Highway 51 at Watson Rd. Blocking half of the road.
Flowing water over Buena Vista Road led to a road closure.
Flash flooding leading to a road closure at Poplar/Union Ave intersection.
Several closed roads_ including south main_ due to covered roadways. Water infiltrated a business and water was up to a cars roof.
Trees down along Hwy 35 S just north of the Tallahatchie / Grenada county line. Time is radar estimated.
Flash flooding occurring near Trumann Elementary school.
Car stuck in water at gas station in Caraway.
Intersection of Highways 69 and 163 is underwater.
Significant water over the roadway at Highway 1 at Weiner Cutoff Road.
Neighborhood roadway completely underwater.
Flash flooding reported at Union and Avalon in Midtown Memphis.
Flash flooding reported at Union and Cleveland in Midtown.
Southbound underpass completely flooded on I-240 at Jefferson Ave. Traffic at standstill.
Shelley Renee Road is flooded.
Water across both lanes on Farm Road in various spots between Walnut Grove Road and Mullins Station Road.
Water covering I-40 EB ramp from Sycamore View Rd NB.
Rushing water in the Lakeland area near hwy64 and Fletcher Trace Pwky.
Flash flooding along Billy Maher Rd_ north of Memphis Arlington Rd in Bartlett.
Indian Creek rose over its embankment onto the roadway of Olive Hill Road_ with deep water and impassable.
